reviewDescription: I use this every single night and I’m not exaggerating when I say it’s one of the best purchases I’ve made. I like to fall asleep listening to Spotify podcasts, and before this, it either meant disturbing my husband or dealing with uncomfortable earbuds. This solved both problems instantly. I can listen to whatever I want, at whatever volume I want, and he sleeps peacefully next to me. Everyone wins. The mask itself is actually comfortable enough to sleep in all night. That was my biggest concern, but it’s soft, stays in place, and doesn’t dig into your ears or feel bulky. I side sleep and it still works just fine. Sound quality is solid for what it is. You’re not getting concert-level audio, but for podcasts or calming music, it’s perfect. Battery life has been reliable, and it’s easy to charge. I’ve made it part of my nightly routine at this point. If you like falling asleep to audio but don’t want to annoy your partner or deal with earbuds, this is a no-brainer.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on March 19, 2026
